question: Is operator-managed retention without a Gitcrawl deletion command acceptable for immutable snapshots containing private review text, and should the publishing credential also hold reader access for final integrity verification?
rationale: The branch deliberately retains normalized review content and broadens authorization at cutover; tests can validate mechanics but cannot choose the permanent disclosure, lifecycle, and least-privilege policy.

options.title: Approve documented operator controls
options.body: Accept the current content and credential boundary after documenting concrete remote expiry or removal procedures and obtaining exact-head runtime proof.

options.title: Require lifecycle and credential separation
options.body: Add bounded deletion or garbage collection and support a distinct reader-verification credential before private-repository rollout.

options.title: Restrict initial rollout
options.body: Limit the feature to non-private archives until lifecycle and least-privilege controls are available.

recommendation.title: Approve documented operator controls
recommendation.body: Accept the current content and credential boundary after documenting concrete remote expiry or removal procedures and obtaining exact-head runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main and branch history identify vincentkoc as the primary owner coordinating the publisher, coverage semantics, and paired remote contract.
